ActivatedTokens.description: Each token counted once by its last observed state: observed data, not necessarily the real state (see coverage). total = activatePaymentNoticeOk.total = sum of the five categories

acceptedOutcome.description: Tokens with at least one state transition triggered by sendPaymentOutcome/V2 (an accepted outcome, OK or KO); V2 when any such transition is V2

cancelledByMod3Cancel.description: No accepted outcome; CANCELLED through the mod3Cancel/mod3CancelV2 expiry job, whenever it happened, also after the window

otherCancelled.description: No accepted outcome; CANCELLED by another cause

nonTerminal.description: No accepted outcome; last observed state not final in the attempt FSM: the final state has not been observed (not necessarily a payment in progress)

otherTerminal.description: No accepted outcome; final state other than CANCELLED

activatePaymentNoticeOk.description: Payment attempts (tokens) created by activatePaymentNotice/V2, i.e. activations with outcome OK: RE payment_PAYING with that tipoEvento, counted once per token in its minute

sendPaymentOutcome.description: sendPaymentOutcome/V2 requests (REQ) received, any outcome, deduplicated, in the minute of the request

tokens.description: Per-token breakdown of activatePaymentNoticeOk (same tokens, window and filters) by last observed state; null when coverage.status is UNAVAILABLE

difference.description: sendPaymentOutcome.total - activatePaymentNoticeOk.total: negative when outcomes are missing. Raw indicator: requests and tokens are not 1:1 (a V2 request may carry up to 5 tokens, a rejected late request is counted); tokens is the per-token figure

AggregateChanges.description: Signed additive differences; durationSnapshot is the authoritative replacement, including an empty array.

status.description: Completeness is never asserted: UNKNOWN when no reliable ingestion watermark proves the timeline complete, UNAVAILABLE when tokens may already be deleted by retention (tokens is null)

lastObservedEventAt.description: Source time of the latest projected attempt state event: observed data, not a coverage guarantee

outcome.description: UNCONFIGURED: no subscription key; UNAVAILABLE: call failed or timed out

paymentToken.description: Payment token as stored by Nodo Online

outcome.description: UNCONFIGURED: no subscription key; UNAVAILABLE: call failed or timed out

CacheVersions.description: Cache version of NDP001 and NDP004 read from Nodo monitoring

nodes.description: One entry per node, NDP001 first; a failing node does not hide the others

DbCheck.description: Read-only comparison with the routed Nodo Online database

logicalState.description: null when the logical snapshot is absent

attemptState.description: null when the attempt snapshot is absent

description.example: An unexpected error has occurred. Please contact support.

Maintenances.description: Scheduled station maintenances of the next 7 days, cached daily

stale.description: True when the last refresh failed and the previous data is served

PaymentChanges.description: Recipient changes/removals are independent of attempts. Omitted optional arrays mean no change, not unsupported recipients.

state.description: Logical position state; null while no position event or logical source snapshot has been observed. Never derived from attempts or recipients.
Logical position state; null while no position event or logical source snapshot has been observed. Never derived from attempts or recipients.

serviceIdentifier.description: Identificativo di servizio; null se non disponibile.

primitive.description: Nome originale della primitiva (tipoEvento RE), senza normalizzazione.

direction.description: Direzione rispetto al Nodo dai campi RE fruitore/erogatore dell'evento REQ: INBOUND se il Nodo è l'erogatore, OUTBOUND se è il fruitore, UNKNOWN altrimenti. Mai dedotta dal nome della primitiva.

warnings.description: Richieste senza risposta entro 10 secondi (tardiva o assente).

calledAt.description: Data-ora (UTC) della richiesta rimasta senza risposta entro 10 secondi.

psp.description: PSP della richiesta; null se non disponibile.

canale.description: Canale della richiesta; null se non disponibile.

paFiscalCode.description: Ente creditore (idDominio) della richiesta; null se non disponibile.

stazione.description: Stazione della richiesta; null se non disponibile.

title.description: A short, summary of the problem type. Written in english and readable for engineers (usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized); example: Service Unavailable

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

details.description: A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
details.example: There was an error processing the request

from.description: Inclusive UTC instant ending in Z

to.description: Exclusive UTC instant; from < to <= from + 24h

cursor.description: Opaque signed seek cursor; repeat the original window

scope.description: ATTEMPT (default): PA + NAV + token of the attempt. POSITION: PA + NAV only, so events without a paymentToken (verifyPaymentNotice) are included, together with those of every token.

RecipientDto.description: Receipt recipient keyed by PA/NAV/stazioneRecipient. No token association or primary role.

stazioneRecipient.description: Null denotes the single unidentified recipient of this logical pair.

outcome.description: SYNCED when the projection changed, otherwise NOOP

state.description: State returned by Nodo Online, or null when the source snapshot is missing

TimelineItemDto.description: Server transition order is authoritative, including repeated states and null or nonmonotonic dates.

trigger.description: Original application trigger from the admitted RE event, when available.

cause.description: tipoEvento of the transition into the last observed state; null when not recorded

byState.description: One item per last observed state, sorted by count, descending

SecurityScheme.description: Microsoft Entra ID token (MSAL ID token), validated by Azure APIM

get.summary: Get info of Node tech support API

parameters.description: Offline node to query (offline-ndp001 or offline-ndp004 service identifier). When omitted, the default offline-ndp004 datasource is used.
parameters.name: serviceIdentifier
